description: Symfony bundle for the auditor PHP audit log library: automatic Doctrine ORM audit logs, entity change history and an audit log viewer. Formerly DoctrineAuditBundle.
rules: auditor-bundle was formerly DoctrineAuditBundle: the DH\DoctrineAuditBundle namespace no longer exists, use DH\AuditorBundle and DH\Auditor.
The bundle configuration lives under the dh_auditor key (config/packages/dh_auditor.yaml).
